explanation: The theorem is the defining property of the library's own definition `coveringLift`. That definition is `(Equiv.ofBijective (F.toPrefunctor.star x.val) _).symm ⟨b', eqToHom x.property ≫ f⟩`. The proof applies the generic lemma `Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply`, which says an equivalence applied to its own inverse gives back the input. That lemma is structural glue and does not carry the content, which lies in the library's definition. I read `Mathlib/Combinatorics/Quiver/Covering.lean`. It provides `Prefunctor.star`, `IsCovering`, `pathStar` and related bijectivity lemmas. It has no lifting construction for covering prefunctors and no matching lemma about one. So no Mathlib declaration states this result.
